column1: # The domain-binding ratchet (the signing envelope §2.5; NETWORK_IDENTITY.md §2.4.1).
# Rows of docs/design/CRYPTO_DOMAIN_REGISTRY.tsv the binding gate
# binding. Each section's count is pinned in that test, so the list can only
# shrink: a row leaves when its site is fixed (the gate refuses a listed row it
# can already prove), and nothing joins without editing the pin. The release
# gate (scripts/release/check_binding_ratchet.py) refuses a cut at or past
# v3.1.0, the genesis release, while any row remains (Rick, 2026-11-05).
#   input-raw  an input:<type> row whose applying function does not take the
#              named type. The site is the function that applies the domain.
#              No type exists yet for a key derived under salt_for, or the
#              function takes raw bytes. Owner: SO-D12, unless a row's note
#              names another; a note that says the input is not what the
#              binding names waits on a ruling, not on a type.
#   unframed   an id or name cSHAKE row not declared as an IdDomain or
#              NameDomain constant: the binding is in its input, but not
#   pending    a production row with no binding the closed lists give
#              without a ruling; its registry binding is "-".
